text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains despite extreme fear conditions, suggesting selective accumulation rather than panic selling. Bitcoin's dominance holding steady at 57.7% with $74B in daily volume indicates the market is trading but not rushing into altcoins, a sign of cautious positioning. The Fear & Greed index near its floor yet ticking upward hints that the worst sentiment may be stabilizing, though the lack of volume surge indicates conviction remains low.
